## Findings
- claim-1: The 2011 source records the stronger quotient statement as suspected, not proved. [source-6@L56-L72|claim=ordinary-document]
- claim-2: Claim 4 of the independent review states: “no bounded 2024 full-text theorem passage with stable locators was supplied,” hence “the requested source-refresh target was **not established**.” [artifact b08e2bc313e8d0e6427cecd8677adc220a3f37ba4c3d7d8037ae8ed24d6ff2ed, lines 26-31]
- claim-3: Thus Claim 4 identifies the decisive deficiency: the required 2024 theorem-level source refresh was not executed. The requested target was explicitly and correctly reported as **not established**, but that source-refresh task remained incomplete. [artifact b08e2bc313e8d0e6427cecd8677adc220a3f37ba4c3d7d8037ae8ed24d6ff2ed, lines 14-18, 26-41]
## Strategy
Inspected immutable snapshot `b08e2bc313e8d0e6427cecd8677adc220a3f37ba4c3d7d8037ae8ed24d6ff2ed`, `artifact.txt@L14-L17, L28, L32-L35`.

Bounded excerpts:
- L14-L17: “no citable FULL-TEXT SOURCE block … Requested target established: **no**.”
- L28: “Provider search ran, but no bounded 2024 full-text theorem passage with stable locators was supplied.”
- L32-L35: “Retrieve … bounded passage containing the exact theorem statement, its hypotheses and coefficient ring … Replace the abstract-only discussion with the required full-text excerpts…”

Thus Claim 4 identifies the decisive deficiency: the required 2024 theorem-level refresh was not completed or supplied. The requested target was correctly reported as **not established**, while the task remained incomplete. This establishes only the historical source-deficiency certificate.

## Gaps
None for this bounded certificate. It supplies no 2024 theorem statement and establishes no parent theorem.

## Next
Any theorem-level 2024 source grounding is separate future work.
